book.name: Mikiyasa
book.title: Mikiyasarini kuku Nuw Mikiyasi Apanllee kuku kamanchintspa

content: Siy Irusarinshuchis saanaatsi tapachindamaam na sundarureetsis kamachtangtsa. Watam tputs siyaa pachamaam katiripeechinawa. Siyaa kasirsin, kurakareetsis uru kiyung yachachinllinaya, átcha Apanlli siyaatsi. Ashiriya, kamaneena yuwaa Babiloniyashuch Israelchichee machtayarusin, Apanllsha undararee tpachingayaru, yusur tapachindachu anootsi.
Ashiriya, Apanll ipusamarini Biringush yakat nllurtachu anoo nuwaa Apanll kamanirangu, anootssha na kamanchintspa
Utaáchich yaktarini zapan kapungutaati taaru, itaru ashiritaa Biringash yakat Israelchicheem urkar nllurtachiya. An nllur zitaminarini sirútama kurakaam kinarangu anchichcha.

Ashiri Apanll Israelchichee natumasamam kasachiya. Itaru, nda urutamari kasachiya. Kiz mireeyaru, tatsipkachu anush yusur Israelchich arapeew pseertaru taarana, anoo washunandsha watsapunish waanpatatssin tushanichiya.

Apanll waana nlluraam wizpur panakchu, waana Apanll Taarashipan tamaparee ashiritam kurak tiptsiree ksutchiya. Opeejpan tamapari ashiru tiptsiree wanasir ksutchiya. Amb ashkachu, Israelchich mapiyrsin wanasir taachinllinaya. Watam tputs ztaru arapeewtaa taakana, an Apanllee kuk ichingarusin mazinchinllinawa. Apanll Taarashipan kizpurcha, táchinllinaya.

Ashiriya Asiriyashuch iyaa Israelchicheetsini kasimaam kuseersin, sundarush pang' kapungush pshtukchusin, uwsha kurak iyaa tapachindachiya. Tsimbun matayaru kurakaa, mishat tuchip matayaru sundarootstam urkar kurak zangankachu, uwapa wizpur Asiriyashchee, Nimrodshuchi tputs kasichiniya. Ashkachuni, yamari kizpureewani Asiriyashchee tpuxtakchuni, ndusha iyash tsapuni yusur kuschinllinaya. Ashiri Apanll ipusamarini Biringush yakat nllurtachu anoo na kamaneena. Na yuwaa iyashuch tputs pseertaru taaksin, Apanll istachu anoo kamanchintspa Apanll nuwaa kamanirangtamta.

Iyashuch, Akoparinchich tputs zapan minpeew tsap wand taaratarar ashchinllinaya. Iyaanpee tsapunni nda kanapuchinllinaya. Anpeewari taaksin Apanllsha waana zandkachu istakchu, ashparitaatsirisha minchicheewaatstam istachiya. Sirin tsapu ashchiri kachachtataru, misha sin sinakchu ashparita tatsumim kachachtataru ashikpaz ashtachiya.

Itaru, iyashchee natsakinaareesinaya, iyashuchsha tputs tumuz manginshuch opeejaa watandpunush zayaru, wanutsee katungambayaru, wanapootstam katungayaru, kasataru, iyashuch ashikpaz ashirusin, natsampanee tputs kachingchinllinaya.
Apaa, shiyamari kundarareetsish izuuru tpachingayarush kasachsha, nuw Mikiyasi atina. Ashiriya, na yuwaa iyashuch tputs pseertaru taaksin, Apanll istachu anoo kamaneena.
Ashiriya, na kamanchintspa yuwaa Apanll ichingaru tputs waneekchu, apanllputseetstam ichingaru tpachingachu anootsi
Nuw Apanlli Taarashipani siyaa Israelchicheetsis atina: Yuwash zar tatsamkachu anush nuw siyaa kapaachureetsis tapazpanee mishat, tapazeem pshiyrshishi payukis anootstam ichingaru tpachingachima.
Wishunureetstamtis, mishat natstampaneetstam yuwamun mangis tatkis, anoo izuuru chingachima.
Apanllputsireetstamtis, mishat patumbcheetstam, yuwaa ungirtapani átus tinarangis, anootstam pátangambeeruri kasachima. Ayamtaati tputs waana tinamarineetsini ungirtachazinllinaja, ndambaree.
Yaktareetssis kapeetkachuri, yasinareetstamtis, yuwaa ungirtakis anootstam yuxeeruri kapeetchima.

Tsapurunas ztaru yuwamand nuwaa kuki kapeetarangana anumand nuw kapung tsiyantakuri, tpachingayaruri kasachima. Nuwaana tsiyani kachizangayaruri, kasachima, atina, Apanll tárangiya. Ashiriya, na kamaneena yuwaa Apanll, ichingaru tputs waneekchu, apanllputseetstam ichingaru tpachingachu, anootsi.

footnotes.text: Yuwaa nish átu anootstam Matiwa 2.6; Wanga 7.42 tayusima kamankiya.
